name: SportQory Sports Support Fund
verdict: Kazakhstan's designated single operator for off-budget sports money, managing Barys and other Astana clubs; its director says the main funds come from the quasi-state sector, with sovereign wealth fund Samruk-Kazyna as general partner.
note: Partner of Barys Astana for 2026/27 (club partnership page; logo on sportqory.kz); the fund has managed Barys itself since 2021. Rating note (2026-10-03): the link is sportqory-state-operator (state-designated single operator for off-budget sports money; per its director the main funds come from the quasi-state sector with Samruk-Kazyna as general partner), and Samruk-Kazyna's sole shareholder is the Government of Kazakhstan (claim samruk-kazyna-government-owner); the record is kazakhstan-january-2022-killings. State with a sourced record directs and funds the sponsor -> proposed tier: serious. ON HOLD pending maintainer review.

why.text: Sport Qory, which manages Barys and appears among its partners, is Kazakhstan's designated single operator for distributing off-budget sports money; its director says the main funds come from the quasi-state sector, with the state's wholly owned fund Samruk-Kazyna as general partner. Under the Kazakh state, the January 2022 protest crackdown left 238 people dead, with officers convicted of torturing detainees and impunity persisting per Amnesty International.
why.messageLine: Sport Qory channels state money through Samruk-Kazyna, whose state killed 238 protesters in 2022.
